quote: If you are contributing to the core Genkit JS SDK (under the `/js` directory), please make sure that all exported members have a valid [JSDoc](https://www.typescriptlang.org/docs/handbook/jsdoc-supported-types.html) associated with them.
statement: In js/**, every exported member must have a valid JSDoc comment.

quote: **Registry-First Thinking**: Genkit is built around a central registry. Always use `genkit.DefineX` (e.g., `DefineFlow`, `DefineTool`) for any component that should be discoverable by tools or the Dev UI.
statement: In go/**, components that should be discoverable by tools or the Dev UI must be created with genkit.DefineX (DefineFlow, DefineTool, ...) so they are registered in the registry.

quote: **Context is Mandatory**: Every Genkit function and tool execution requires a `context.Context`. Pass it through faithfully;
statement: In go/**, every Genkit function and tool execution must take a context.Context and pass it through to callees.

quote: never use `context.Background()` inside an implementation unless it is the entry point.
statement: In go/**, implementation code must not call context.Background() except at the program entry point.

quote: **Schema Strictness**: When defining input/output types for Flows or Tools, use clear, JSON-tagged Go structs. The model uses these tags and types to understand the interface.
statement: In go/**, input and output types of Flows and Tools must be Go structs with json struct tags on their fields.
scope: go/** flow and tool input/output types

quote: **Search Before Implementing**: Many common utilities exist in `internal/base` or `ai/`. Check there before implementing new JSON parsing or string manipulation logic.
statement: In go/**, code should reuse JSON parsing and string utilities from go/internal/base or go/ai instead of reimplementing them.
scope: go/** JSON parsing and string helpers

quote: **Idiomatic Concurrency**: Prefer Go's native concurrency (goroutines/channels) but be mindful of the `context` lifecycle within long-running background tasks.
statement: In go/**, concurrent code should use goroutines/channels and respect the context lifecycle in long-running background tasks.

quote: **`NewX`** (e.g., `NewTool`): Creates a component **without registering it**. Use this for internal components, dynamic creation, or testing.
statement: In go/**, internal, dynamically created or test-only components should be created with NewX (e.g. NewTool) rather than DefineX so they are not registered.

quote: Use functional options (e.g., `ai.WithModel`, `genkit.WithPlugins`) for optional configuration parameters in constructors and method calls.
statement: In go/**, optional configuration parameters of constructors and methods must be expressed as functional options (e.g. ai.WithModel, genkit.WithPlugins).

quote: Use `genkit.DefineFlow` for orchestration tasks. Use typed structs for input and output to ensure schema generation.
statement: In go/**, orchestration tasks must be defined with genkit.DefineFlow using typed struct input and output types.

quote: // Use genkit.Run to create a trace span for a specific step
statement: In go/** flows, discrete steps inside a flow should be wrapped in genkit.Run(ctx, name, fn) to create a trace span.

quote: Tools are used by models. The description is crucial as the model uses it to decide when to call the tool.
statement: In go/**, tools defined with genkit.DefineTool should have a meaningful description argument.

quote: Use `genkit.GenerateData` to get structured output from a model directly into a Go struct.
statement: In go/**, structured model output into a Go struct should be obtained with genkit.GenerateData[T] rather than manual JSON parsing of generated text.

quote: **Strict Typing**: Go is statically typed. Do not use `interface{}` (or `any`) unless absolutely necessary and documented.
statement: In go/**, code must not use interface{} or any unless absolutely necessary and documented with a comment.

quote: **No Warning Suppression**: Avoid ignoring linter warnings unless there is a compelling, documented reason.
statement: In go/**, code should not suppress linter warnings (e.g. //nolint) without a documented reason.

quote: Group imports: standard library first, then third-party, then internal. `goimports` handles this automatically.
statement: In go/**, imports must be grouped standard library, then third-party, then internal.

quote: **Do Not Edit Generated Files**: Files generated by tools (like protobufs or strict-type generators) should not be modified directly.
statement: In go/**, generated files (protobufs, type generators) must not be modified by hand.

quote: **Do Not Edit gen.go**: `go/ai/gen.go` is an auto-generated file. **DO NOT MODIFY IT DIRECTLY.**
statement: go/ai/gen.go must not be edited directly; it is regenerated by jsonschemagen.

quote: **Generator/Sanitizer**: Any necessary transformations to the core types must be applied to the generator script or the schema sanitizer.
statement: In go/**, transformations to core generated types must be implemented in the generator script or schema sanitizer, not in generated output.

quote: **Canonical Parity**: The data model MUST be identical to the JSON schema defined in the JavaScript (canonical) implementation.
statement: In go/**, the Go data model must be identical to the JSON schema of the canonical JavaScript implementation.

quote: **Overwrite Risk**: Do not edit `genkit-tools/genkit-schema.json` directly. It is a generated file and will be overwritten by the `export:schemas` script.
statement: genkit-tools/genkit-schema.json must not be edited directly; change the Zod schemas in genkit-tools/common/src/types/ and regenerate.

quote: When adding new Part types, ensure `schemas.config` is updated to add the new Part type on all existing Parts and add "omit" to it accordingly.
statement: When adding a new Part type, go/core/schemas.config must be updated to add the new Part type to all existing Parts with "omit".

quote: Use idioms like `if err != nil` for error handling.
statement: In go/**, errors must be handled with explicit `if err != nil` checks.

quote: Prefer short variable names for short scopes (e.g., `i` for index, `ctx` for context).
statement: In go/**, variables in short scopes should use short names (e.g. i for index, ctx for context.Context).

quote: **Interfaces**: Define interfaces where they are used (consumer-side), not where they are implemented (producer-side).
statement: In go/**, interfaces must be declared in the consuming package, not in the package that implements them.

quote: **Concurrency**: Use channels and goroutines for concurrency. Avoid shared mutable state where possible.
statement: In go/**, concurrent code should use channels and goroutines and avoid shared mutable state.

quote: Use proper punctuation.
statement: In go/**, code comments must use proper punctuation (full sentences ending with a period).

quote: Start function comments with the function name.
statement: In go/**, function doc comments must start with the function's name.

quote: Use `// TODO(issue-id): Fix this later.` format for stubs.
statement: In go/**, TODO comments must use the format `// TODO(issue-id): description.`

quote: **Format**: Write comprehensive GoDoc-style comments for exported packages, types, and functions.
statement: In go/**, exported packages, types and functions must have GoDoc-style doc comments.

quote: **Examples**: Provide examples for complex APIs (using `Example` functions in `_test.go` files is best practice).
statement: In go/**, complex APIs should have Example functions in _test.go files.
scope: go/** _test.go files for complex public APIs

quote:
Always add unit tests to improve coverage. Use Genkit primitives and helper
functions instead of mocking types.
statement: In go/** tests, code must use Genkit primitives and helper functions instead of mocking Genkit types.

quote: Use default input values for flows and actions to make them easier to use.
statement: In go/**, flows and actions should declare default input values.

quote: In the samples, explain the whys, hows, and whats of the sample in the package comment so the user learns more about the feature being demonstrated. Also explain how to test the sample.
statement: In go/samples/**, each sample's package comment must explain what the sample demonstrates, why and how, and how to test it.

quote: Avoid mentioning sample specific stuff in core framework or plugin code.
statement: In go/** core framework and plugin code (outside go/samples), code and comments should not reference sample-specific details.

quote: Always check for missing dependencies in `go.mod` for each sample and add them if we're using them.
statement: In go/samples/**, every imported module must be listed in the sample's go.mod.

quote: Avoid boilerplate comments in the code. Comments should tell why, not what.
statement: In go/**, comments should explain why rather than restate what the code does; avoid boilerplate comments.

quote: Make sure to not leave any dead code or unused imports.
statement: In go/**, code must not contain dead code or unused imports.

quote: **Line Length**: Go doesn't have a strict line length limit, but keep it reasonable (e.g., 80-100 characters).
statement: In go/**, lines should be kept to roughly 80-100 characters.

quote: **Framework**: Use the standard `testing` package. **Do not use external assertion libraries (like `testify`) for new core code.**
statement: In go/** core tests, test code must use the standard testing package and must not import external assertion libraries such as github.com/stretchr/testify.
scope: go/** _test.go files (new core code; existing plugins exempt)

quote: **Assertions**: Use plain `if/else` blocks following the `want`/`got` pattern.
statement: In go/** tests, assertions must be plain if blocks comparing got and want, reporting via t.Errorf("f() = %v, want %v", got, want).

quote: For complex object comparisons (structs, slices, maps), use `github.com/google/go-cmp/cmp` (and `cmpopts` if needed).
statement: In go/** tests, comparisons of structs, slices and maps must use cmp.Diff from github.com/google/go-cmp/cmp (with cmpopts as needed) and report "mismatch (-want +got)".

quote: **Fixes**: Fix underlying code issues rather than special-casing tests.
statement: In go/**, production code must not special-case tests; fix the underlying issue instead.

quote: **Modernize**: Consider using `modernize` to update code to modern Go idioms (e.g., `slices`, `maps`) when fixing underlying issues.
statement: In go/**, code should use modern Go idioms such as the slices and maps standard packages instead of hand-written loops.

quote: **Test Actions Directly**: Use `flow.Run(ctx, input)` or `tool.Run(ctx, input)` to test the logic of your Genkit components.
statement: In go/** tests, Genkit flows and tools should be tested by calling flow.Run(ctx, input) or tool.Run(ctx, input) directly.

quote: **Verify Schemas**: Ensure that the `Action` returned by `DefineX` has the expected input and output schemas.
statement: In go/** tests, tests of components created with DefineX should assert the Action's input and output schemas.

quote: **Mock Models**: When testing Flows that call models, use a mock model implementation to ensure deterministic tests.
statement: In go/** tests, flows that call models must be tested against a mock model implementation, not a live model.

quote: **Trace Inspection**: For complex flows, use tests to verify that `genkit.Run` steps are being executed as expected.
statement: In go/** tests, tests of complex flows should verify that genkit.Run steps execute as expected.

quote: Use the `core/logger` package-level functions (`logger.Debug(ctx, ...)`, `logger.Info`, `logger.Warn`, `logger.Error`) whenever a `context.Context` is available; ... Fall back to `log/slog` only where there is no context (package init, load-time code).
statement: In go/**, logging must use the core/logger package functions (logger.Debug/Info/Warn/Error with ctx) whenever a context.Context is available; log/slog may be used only where no context exists.

quote: Use structured logging keys and values. Messages are lowercase, stable phrases with no trailing punctuation;
statement: In go/**, log messages must be lowercase stable phrases without trailing punctuation, with structured key/value attributes.

quote: put variable data in attributes, never `fmt.Sprintf` into the message.
statement: In go/**, log calls must not build the message with fmt.Sprintf; variable data goes into attributes.

quote: Use `"error"` (not `"err"`) as the key for errors.
statement: In go/**, log calls must use the attribute key "error" (not "err") for error values.

quote: **Levels**: `Debug` for per-request detail (spans, model turns, tool runs, middleware hooks); `Info` sparingly for one-time lifecycle events (init complete, server listening); `Warn` for misconfiguration, fallbacks, and skipped work; `Error` only where the error is not also returned
statement: In go/**, log levels must follow: Debug for per-request detail, Info only for one-time lifecycle events, Warn for misconfiguration/fallbacks/skipped work, Error only where the error is not returned to the caller.

quote: Never log-and-return the same error.
statement: In go/**, code must not both log an error and return that same error.

quote: Include the Apache 2.0 license header at the top of each file (update year as needed):
statement: In go/**, every source file must begin with the Google LLC Apache 2.0 license header including the SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0 line.

quote:
Use **kebab-case** with colon separators for subcommands.

- **Format**: `noun:verb` or `category:action`
statement: In genkit-tools/cli/src/commands/**, CLI command names must be kebab-case with colon-separated subcommands in noun:verb form (e.g. flow:run, eval:run).

quote: **Arguments**: Use camelCase in code (`flowName`) but standard format in help text (`<flowName>`).
statement: In genkit-tools/cli/src/commands/**, command arguments must be camelCase in code and written as <argName> in help text.

quote:
Use **snake_case** for tool names to align with MCP standards.

- **Format**: `verb_noun`
statement: In genkit-tools/cli/src/mcp/**, MCP tool names must be snake_case in verb_noun form (e.g. list_flows, run_flow).

quote: Commands are implemented in `cli/src/commands/` using `commander`.
statement: In genkit-tools/cli, CLI commands must be implemented in genkit-tools/cli/src/commands/ using the commander package.

quote: Most commands require interacting with the user's project runtime. Use the `runWithManager` utility to handle the lifecycle of the runtime process.
statement: In genkit-tools/cli/src/commands/**, commands that interact with the project runtime must wrap that work in runWithManager(projectRoot, async (manager) => ...) from utils/manager-utils.

quote: **Logging**: Use `logger` from `@genkit-ai/tools-common/utils`.
statement: In genkit-tools/cli/src/**, logging must use logger imported from @genkit-ai/tools-common/utils (not console).

quote: **Machine Readable**: Provide options for JSON output or file writing when the command produces data.
statement: In genkit-tools/cli/src/commands/**, commands that produce data should offer an option for JSON output or writing to a file.

quote: **Streaming**: If the operation supports streaming (like `flow:run`), provide a `--stream` flag and pipe output to stdout.
statement: In genkit-tools/cli/src/commands/**, commands for streaming-capable operations must provide a --stream flag that pipes output to stdout.

quote:
- **Registration**: `defineDocsTool(server: McpServer)`
- **Dependencies**: Only the `server` instance.
statement: In genkit-tools/cli/src/mcp/**, static MCP tools (no project runtime) must be registered by a defineXTool(server: McpServer) function that depends only on the server instance.

quote:
- **Registration**: `defineRuntimeTools(server: McpServer, options: McpToolOptions)`
- **Dependencies**: Requires `options` containing `manager` (process manager) and `projectRoot`.
statement: In genkit-tools/cli/src/mcp/**, runtime MCP tools must be registered by a function taking (server: McpServer, options: McpToolOptions) and access the runtime via options.manager and options.projectRoot.

quote: **Schema**: MUST use `getCommonSchema(options.explicitProjectRoot, ...)` to ensure the tool can accept a `projectRoot` argument when required (e.g., in multi-project environments).
statement: In genkit-tools/cli/src/mcp/**, runtime MCP tools must build their inputSchema with getCommonSchema(options.explicitProjectRoot, ...).

In genkit-tools/cli/src/mcp/**, runtime MCP tool handlers should call resolveProjectRoot(options.explicitProjectRoot, opts, options.projectRoot) before acting and return the error result if it is not a string.

quote: MCP tools should generally catch errors and return them as content blocks with `isError: true` rather than throwing exceptions, which ensures the client receives a structured error response.
statement: In genkit-tools/cli/src/mcp/**, MCP tool handlers should catch errors and return { isError: true, content: [{ type: 'text', text: `Error: ...` }] } instead of throwing.

quote: [tool.ruff] line-length = 120
statement: In py/**, Python lines must not exceed 120 characters.

quote: ignore = ["S101", # assert used - we use assert for type narrowing and tests
statement: In py/**, the ruff bandit rule S101 (use of assert) is disabled; assert may be used.

quote: "S105", # hardcoded password string - false positives in tests
statement: In py/**, the ruff rule S105 (hardcoded password string) is disabled.

quote: "S106", # hardcoded password func arg - false positives in tests
statement: In py/**, the ruff rule S106 (hardcoded password function argument) is disabled.

quote: "S311", # random not for security - we don't use random for crypto
statement: In py/**, the ruff rule S311 (non-cryptographic random) is disabled; the random module may be used.

quote: select = ["E", # pycodestyle (errors)
statement: In py/**, Python code must pass ruff pycodestyle error rules (E).

quote: "W", # pycodestyle (warnings)
statement: In py/**, Python code must pass ruff pycodestyle warning rules (W).

quote: "F", # pyflakes
statement: In py/**, Python code must pass ruff pyflakes rules (F): no undefined names, unused imports/variables, etc.

quote: "I", # isort (import sorting)  [lint.isort] combine-as-imports = true, known-first-party = ["genkit"], section-order = [future, standard-library, third-party, first-party, local-folder]
statement: In py/**, imports must be sorted by ruff isort with sections future, standard-library, third-party, first-party (genkit), local-folder and combined as-imports.

quote: "UP", # pyupgrade (Python version upgrades)
statement: In py/**, Python code must use modern syntax for the py310 target as enforced by ruff pyupgrade (UP), e.g. X | Y unions and builtin generics.

quote: "B", # flake8-bugbear (common bugs)
statement: In py/**, Python code must pass ruff flake8-bugbear rules (B), e.g. no mutable default arguments.

quote: "N", # pep8-naming (naming conventions)
statement: In py/**, Python names must follow PEP 8 naming conventions (ruff N): snake_case functions/variables, CapWords classes.

quote: "D", # pydocstyle  [lint.pydocstyle] convention = "google"
statement: In py/**, public modules, classes and functions must have docstrings following the Google docstring convention (ruff D, pydocstyle convention = google).

quote: "ANN", # flake8-annotations (type hints)
statement: In py/**, function arguments and return values must have type annotations, and Any must not be used for *args/**kwargs (ruff ANN, including ANN401).

quote: "F401", # unused imports
statement: In py/**, modules must not contain unused imports (ruff F401).

quote: "F403", # wildcard imports
statement: In py/**, code must not use wildcard imports (from x import *) (ruff F403).

quote: "F841", # unused variables
statement: In py/**, code must not assign local variables that are never used (ruff F841).

quote: "S", # flake8-bandit (security)
statement: In py/**, Python code must pass ruff flake8-bandit security rules (S), except S101, S105, S106 and S311.

quote: "ASYNC", # flake8-async (async best practices)
statement: In py/**, async functions must not make blocking calls (blocking I/O, time.sleep, sync HTTP) as enforced by ruff flake8-async (ASYNC).

quote: "T20", # flake8-print (no print statements)
statement: In py/**, code must not use print() or pprint() (ruff T20).

quote: "TD", # flake8-todos (TODO comment formatting and issue links)
statement: In py/**, TODO comments must follow flake8-todos format: `# TODO(author): description` with an issue link (ruff TD).

quote: "TID251", # banned-api (see flake8-tidy-imports.banned-api below)
statement: In py/**, code must not use APIs listed in [tool.ruff.lint.flake8-tidy-imports.banned-api] (ruff TID251).

quote: "genkit._ai".msg = "genkit._ai is private; import from a public genkit module (genkit, genkit.model, genkit.plugin_api, ...)."
statement: In py/packages/* plugins (other than core genkit) and py/samples/**, code must not import genkit._ai; import from public genkit modules (genkit, genkit.model, genkit.plugin_api, ...).

quote: "genkit._core".msg = "genkit._core is private; import from a public genkit module (genkit, genkit.model, genkit.plugin_api, ...)."
statement: In py/packages/* plugins (other than core genkit) and py/samples/**, code must not import genkit._core; import from public genkit modules.

quote: "genkit.exp._api".msg = "genkit.exp._api is private; import from genkit.exp."
statement: In py/packages/* plugins (other than core genkit) and py/samples/**, code must not import genkit.exp._api; import from genkit.exp.

quote: "genkit.web._sse".msg = "genkit.web._sse is private; import from genkit.web."
statement: In py/packages/* plugins (other than core genkit) and py/samples/**, code must not import genkit.web._sse; import from genkit.web.

quote: "genkit.testing._models".msg = "genkit.testing._models is private; import from genkit.testing."
statement: In py/packages/* plugins (other than core genkit) and py/samples/**, code must not import genkit.testing._models; import from genkit.testing.

quote: "structlog.get_logger".msg = "Use genkit.get_logger; structlog.get_logger lines never reach the Dev UI trace panel."
statement: In py/**, code must not call structlog.get_logger; use genkit.get_logger so logs reach the Dev UI trace panel.

quote: "logging.getLogger".msg = "Use genkit.get_logger; stdlib logger lines never reach the Dev UI trace panel."
statement: In py/**, code must not call logging.getLogger; use genkit.get_logger so logs reach the Dev UI trace panel.

quote: TID251 per-file ignores belong ONLY on core `genkit` files. Never add a plugin path here: ... legitimate plugin logger or whitebox-test exceptions must use line-scoped `# noqa: TID251` instead.
statement: In py/packages/genkit-* plugins, TID251 exceptions must be line-scoped `# noqa: TID251` comments, never file-wide per-file-ignores.

quote: "packages/genkit/src/genkit/_core/_typing.py" = ["E501"]
statement: In py/packages/genkit/src/genkit/_core/_typing.py (generated), ruff E501 line-length is disabled.

quote: "packages/genkit/src/genkit/_core/_base.py" = ["ANN401"]
statement: In py/packages/genkit/src/genkit/_core/_base.py, ruff ANN401 is disabled so **kwargs: Any may be used.

quote: "packages/genkit/src/genkit/_ai/_json_patch.py" = ["ANN401"]
statement: In py/packages/genkit/src/genkit/_ai/_json_patch.py, ruff ANN401 is disabled so Any may be used.

quote: "packages/genkit-google-cloud/src/genkit_google_cloud/_telemetry/_adjusting_exporter.py" = ["ANN401"]
statement: In py/packages/genkit-google-cloud/src/genkit_google_cloud/_telemetry/_adjusting_exporter.py, ruff ANN401 is disabled so Any may be used.

quote: "packages/genkit/src/genkit/_core/_telemetry/*.py" = ["D"]
statement: In py/packages/genkit/src/genkit/_core/_telemetry/*.py, ruff pydocstyle (D) docstring rules are disabled.

quote: "packages/genkit/src/genkit/_ai/_document.py" = ["F401"]
statement: In py/packages/genkit/src/genkit/_ai/_document.py (re-export module), ruff F401 unused-import is disabled.

quote: "packages/genkit/src/genkit/_ai/_model.py" = ["F401"]
statement: In py/packages/genkit/src/genkit/_ai/_model.py (re-export module), ruff F401 unused-import is disabled.

quote: "packages/genkit/src/genkit/_ai/_testing.py" = ["F401"]
statement: In py/packages/genkit/src/genkit/_ai/_testing.py (re-export module), ruff F401 unused-import is disabled.
In py/**/tests/**/*.py, ruff docstring (D) and annotation (ANN) rules are disabled; tests need no docstrings or type annotations.

quote: "packages/genkit/tests/typing/*.py" = ["D", "F821", "F841", "B018", "ANN"]
statement: In py/packages/genkit/tests/typing/*.py, ruff rules D, F821, F841, B018 and ANN are disabled.
enforced_by: ruff D, F821, F841, B018, ANN

statement: In py/samples/**/*.py, ruff rules ANN, D, E402, ASYNC and T201 are disabled: samples may omit annotations/docstrings, use blocking I/O, print and top-level execution.
enforced_by: ruff ANN, D, E402, ASYNC, T201

quote: "packages/genkit/src/genkit/_core/_logger.py" = ["TID251"]
statement: In py/packages/genkit/src/genkit/_core/_logger.py (defines get_logger), the TID251 banned-api rule is disabled.

quote: "packages/genkit/src/genkit/web/_sse.py" = ["TID251"]
statement: In py/packages/genkit/src/genkit/web/_sse.py, the TID251 banned-api rule is disabled (stdlib logging allowed).

quote: "packages/genkit/tests/**" = ["TID251"]
statement: In py/packages/genkit/tests/**, the TID251 banned-api rule is disabled so tests may import genkit._* internals and stdlib loggers.

quote: [tool.pytest.ini_options] python_files = ["*_test.py"]
statement: In py/**, pytest test modules must be named *_test.py.

quote: asyncio_mode = "strict"
statement: In py/** tests, async test functions and fixtures must be explicitly marked (@pytest.mark.asyncio / pytest_asyncio.fixture) because pytest-asyncio runs in strict mode.

quote: Typing contracts live in packages/*/tests/typecheck/: snake_case kwargs and typed values that pyright, pyrefly and ty must all accept with no suppressions. The only ignores are on lines that assert a type error.
statement: In py/packages/*/tests/typecheck/**, typing contract files must use snake_case kwargs and typed values with no type-checker suppressions except on lines asserting a type error.

quote: [tool.pyright] reportMissingImports = true
statement: In py/packages/**/src and tests/typecheck, all imports must resolve (pyright reportMissingImports).

quote: reportMissingTypeStubs = false
statement: In py/**, pyright reportMissingTypeStubs is disabled; imports of untyped packages without stubs are allowed.

quote: typeCheckingMode = "basic"
statement: In py/packages/**/src and tests/typecheck, code must type-check under pyright basic mode.

quote: [tool.pyrefly.errors] deprecated = "error"
statement: In pyrefly-checked code (py/packages/genkit/src, genkit-mcp/src, genkit-otel/src, tests/typecheck), code must not use deprecated APIs.

quote: redundant-cast = "error"
statement: In pyrefly-checked code, code must not contain redundant typing.cast calls.

quote: [[tool.pyrefly.sub-config]] matches = "packages/*/tests/typecheck/**" ... unused-ignore = "error"
statement: In py/packages/*/tests/typecheck/**, `pyrefly: ignore` comments must not be unused.

quote: [tool.ty.rules] unused-type-ignore-comment = "ignore"
statement: In py/**, ty's unused-type-ignore-comment rule is disabled.

quote: [[tool.ty.overrides]] include = ["**/tests/**", "**/*_test.py", "samples/**", "tools/**"] invalid-argument-type = "ignore"
statement: In py tests, samples and tools, ty's invalid-argument-type rule is disabled.

quote: no-matching-overload = "ignore"
statement: In py tests, samples and tools, ty's no-matching-overload rule is disabled.

quote: [[tool.ty.overrides]] include = ["**/tests/typecheck/**"] invalid-argument-type = "error"
statement: In py/**/tests/typecheck/**, calls must not pass arguments of invalid type (ty invalid-argument-type is an error).

quote: no-matching-overload = "error"
statement: In py/**/tests/typecheck/**, calls must match a declared overload (ty no-matching-overload is an error).

quote: unused-ignore-comment = "error"
statement: In py/**/tests/typecheck/**, `ty: ignore` comments must not be unused.

quote: [[tool.ty.overrides]] include = ["packages/genkit/src/genkit/_ai/_formats/_schema.py"] invalid-argument-type = "ignore"
statement: In py/packages/genkit/src/genkit/_ai/_formats/_schema.py, ty's invalid-argument-type rule is disabled.

quote: [lint.flake8-tidy-imports.banned-api] (replaces the workspace table: genkit._ai, genkit._core, genkit.exp._api, genkit.web._sse, genkit.testing._models are no longer banned inside core genkit)
statement: In py/packages/genkit/**, the private-module import bans (genkit._ai, genkit._core, genkit.exp._api, genkit.web._sse, genkit.testing._models) are turned off so core modules may import each other's internals.

quote: "structlog.get_logger".msg = "Use genkit.get_logger; structlog.get_logger lines never reach the Dev UI trace panel."
statement: In py/packages/genkit/**, code must not call structlog.get_logger; use genkit.get_logger.

quote: "logging.getLogger".msg = "Use genkit.get_logger; stdlib logger lines never reach the Dev UI trace panel."
statement: In py/packages/genkit/**, code must not call logging.getLogger; use genkit.get_logger.

quote: (`packages/genkit/ruff.toml` replaces this table inside core `genkit` so internal modules can import each other while keeping the logger ban in (2). Copy any new non-private entry there too.)
statement: Any new non-private banned-api entry added to py/pyproject.toml must also be copied into py/packages/genkit/ruff.toml.
